messages.author: 474f198ce631ba9d
messages.subject: convergence criteria
parts:
Does anyone know what convergence criteria lavaan uses for SEM?
Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: convergence criteria
parts:
lavInspect(fit, "optim")

will show all the details. Except the number of iterations, they are the
defaults from nlminb(). You can change them using the control= argument,
which is passed directly to the optimizer.

Yves.
